verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork explicitly lets users describe an outcome, step away, and return to finished work for review, with multi-step task execution and scheduled/on-demand delegation documented across several first-party docs (browser use, computer use, recurring tasks). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the autonomous background delegation workflow (community evidence covers coding/research quality but not Cowork specifically) and detail on review/approval UX.
